## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is — e.g. "I'm
always frustrated when [...]". If it's not tied to a specific problem,
just describe the gap.

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered.

## Priority

How much does this matter to you/your use case? P0 (blocking) .. P4
(nice to have, no rush).
[Reference — Google Issue Tracker priority levels](https://developers.google.com/issue-tracker/concepts/issues#priority)

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature
request here.
